---
name: Design feedback
about: Report an implementation question, defect, or design change
---

## Context
Game, handover version, requirement IDs, implementation PR and commit.

## Expected and observed behavior
Include steps, environment, and evidence.

## Impact
Blocking scope or nonblocking suggestion.

## Proposed options
Distinguish implementation defect from design change.

## Resolution
Link decision, approval, replacement handover if needed, fix, verification, and owner acceptance.
